name: Agent Vitals
tagline: Is the service up, and what shape is it in.
summary: Internal status, uptime, host metrics, security posture, and log-summary endpoints packaged as a future customer-facing vitals view. Lowest friction once the dashboard is polished.
description: Agent Vitals is the entry-tier packaging of the existing monitoring dashboard. Today the repository exposes internal Flask routes for service status, uptime, CPU/memory/disk metrics, a security-feature snapshot, and log summaries. It does not currently expose buyer-ready per-agent cost attribution, token/tool-call budget controls, or outbound alert webhooks, so the SKU is not sellable until the surface is rebuilt around what exists.
buyer: An operator who wants a quick pulse on deployment health before they need forensic audit or compliance workflow depth.

features.name: Service status
features.detail: Healthy/unhealthy status with timestamp and uptime seconds from `/api/monitoring/status`.

features.name: System metrics
features.detail: CPU, memory, disk, process, platform, and uptime metrics from `/api/monitoring/metrics`.

features.name: Security snapshot
features.detail: Current authentication, rate-limit, security-header, logging, and validation flags from `/api/monitoring/security`.

features.name: Log summary
features.detail: Existing logger statistics surfaced through `/api/monitoring/logs` when logging is available.

features.name: Customer-facing polish blocker
features.detail: The current dashboard is an internal operational surface, not a packaged buyer view.

source_components.maps_to: src/sincor2/monitoring_dashboard.py — internal Flask routes for status, metrics, security, and log summaries; not yet a buyer-ready dashboard.

readiness.blocker: The existing monitoring_dashboard surface is internal and does not yet support a customer-facing vitals workflow.
readiness.next_action: Productize the current status/metrics/security/log endpoints into a buyer-facing dashboard before quoting OBS-01.
